body: BUG-1213 round 2: your CI fixups landed and Build is green, but the drain reviewer requested changes on two things (verdict at PR-1924.json; full text also on the spec as a ROUND 3 comment): (1) the loop guard compares against ANY historical identical findings comment, so A→B→A escalates on the second A — compare only the immediately previous blocking findings (or hash) and add the two-consecutive-identical vs A→B→A test; (2) mcp::tests::queue_rework_flips_status_and_requeues fails under `cargo test -p aida-cli-lib rework` (expects requeue, queue empty) — probably the fixture trips the new escalation branch; fix (1) likely fixes it, but reproduce locally. Same arrangement as round 2: push to bug-1213 and re-drive; my gate verdict on the guard itself is already APPROVE, so I release the hold as soon as the reviewer passes. Items 3-4 (computed round number, content-based predicate) are TASK-1265, queued drain-safe. BUG-1219 remains queued for whenever you launch.
